production_model: Cut and sewn in Canada from Japanese denim
notes: About: 'raw denim from Japan, cut and sewn in Canada'; 'no pre-distressing, no flashy embroidery, and no fancy washes'; launched 2008 (https://nakedandfamousdenim.com/pages/about). Store description: 'Free hemming. Worldwide shipping.' Store city Montréal (meta.json).

Shipping: United States $10 USD flat via FedEx; US orders generally ship duties paid, Made in Japan items excluded and may carry import duties; hemming adds about 7–14 business days (https://nakedandfamousdenim.com/policies/shipping-policy).
Returns within 30 days of delivery as store credit only (digital gift card), not hemmed; $15 prepaid label deducted if used; sale items final (https://nakedandfamousdenim.com/policies/refund-policy).
Jeans waists (products.json): 27–34, 36, 38, 40, 42, 44 on men's fits; 23–26 on women's fits.
